- [IRET.28.14.3] For the multimap tables (`[IRET.28.8]`) the per-entry
  `vsize` is `sizeof(oa_list)`, which carries `OA_LIST_INLINE` (= 8) inline
  element pointers — `8·8 = 64` bytes plus the `heap`/`n`/`heap_cap`
  fields. This is the same inline footprint as the pre-`oa` tables
  (`DS_RIDX_INLINE = 8`), so the migration is memory- and RT-neutral for
  those tables; the only delta is the `oa` per-slot overhead above.
